Name: Customize Wedding Attire
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
[size=5]What This Mod Does[/size]
Before version 1.6, Stardew Valley used to make you wear a tuxedo to every wedding if you select the male body type, and leaves you in your normal clothing if you selected the female body type. This mod allows you to pick what you wear to a wedding, whether it is a tuxedo, a wedding dress, your normal clothes, the pre-1.6 game default, or a completely custom outfit of your choosing.

[size=5]Config Options
[/size][list]
[*]WeddingAttire: which type of wedding attire you want to wear (tuxOption, dressOption, noneOption, defaultOption, or customOption)
[*]CustomShirt: string ID of the shirt to wear if the custom option is selected
[*]CustomPants: string ID of the pants to wear if the custom option is selected
[*]PantsR, PantsG, PantsB: color of the pants to wear if the custom option is selected, in RGB color encoding
[/list]
[size=5]Optional Helpful Mods to Install[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] allows you to configure the mod from within the game, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url] allows you to see a live preview of the outfit from the configurations page. See their mod descriptions if you have questions about those aspects. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] can help you figure out what the string IDs of different pants/shirts are, or you can unpack the game files and take a look in them. 

[size=5]More Information[/size]
See [url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/CustomizeWeddingAttire#readme]Github readme file[/url] for details on compatibility, configurations, and credits.
See [url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/CustomizeWeddingAttire/blob/main/docs/ReleaseNotes.md]Github release notes[/url] for release notes.
